It binds full15, C3 high-precision A, and analytically accepted C4 owners; runs U1/U2, cleanarch, getfu's second LLL factor, and exact Ufinal/Wraw composition; and publishes an immutable content-addressed owner. The native root was compiled and its JavaScript preflight exercised, but broad native, baselib strict, non-Linux, and full high-precision gates are deferred to integration.
